design.name: 邪飞天·琵琶
design.brief: The corrupted apsara's Chinese pipa, modelled separately: it floats in front of her by magic.
design.turnaround_pose: , standing upright with its neck pointing straight up: a pear-shaped body with a flat golden soundboard painted with faded Dunhuang cloud patterns in cinnabar and malachite green, a rounded dark wooden back, four strings, a short bent-back head with FOUR chunky tuning pegs (two on each side) that glow bright white-gold (painted as opaque bright gold-white, no halo), a small golden sun-disc ornament on the head, a red silk tassel hanging from the bottom; chunky simplified game-art forms with clean bevelled edges, same colours and stylization as the pipa on the design sheet
design.turnaround_digits: All four tuning pegs, the head ornament and the tassel fully inside the frame; in the side views the thin profile and the bent-back head must be clearly readable.
